title: File:Location of the Galactic centre in the night sky (eso1920c).tiff
desc: This chart shows the location of the Milky Way central region in the night sky. It lies in the direction of the constellation of Sagittarius (The Archer), and is marked with a red circle in the image. This map shows most of the stars visible to the unaided eye under good conditions.

title: File:Night Sky Over the Maple Trees.jpg
desc: This starry night captures the absolute lack of light pollution above the Vermont Appalachian. Captured are two meteors overlaying the cloud-like glow of the Milky Way. Look around, and you might make out a few familiar constellations.
